user.title: Connect SMS Broadcast
user.description: Enter your SMS Broadcast credentials. Setup checks your balance without sending an SMS. Use an approved sender ID, or leave it empty to use the provider's two-way number.

error.invalid_auth: SMS Broadcast rejected the credentials. Check your username, password and API access permissions.
error.cannot_connect: Could not retrieve the account balance. Check your connection and SMS Broadcast account settings.
error.invalid_sender: Use an empty sender or up to 11 letters/numbers, without spaces or punctuation.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one SMS Broadcast account is supported.
